name: Homelab Glance
creator: Joshua Ferguson
desc: Home Assistant, Uptime Kuma, Proxmox, Prometheus, Kubernetes and Docker status at a glance.

HA_URL.label: Home Assistant URL
HA_URL.description: e.g. http://192.168.0.20:8123 - leave empty to hide

HA_ENTITIES.label: Home Assistant entities
HA_ENTITIES.description: Comma-separated entity IDs, up to 12, e.g. sensor.living_temp, light.desk

HA_CA_FILE.label: HA: CA certificate file
HA_CA_FILE.description: Optional path on the device to a PEM CA that signed the service's certificate (safer than *_INSECURE)

HA_INSECURE.label: Home Assistant: skip TLS check
HA_INSECURE.description: true only for a self-signed HA certificate you can't add via HA_CA_FILE

KUMA_URL.label: Uptime Kuma URL
KUMA_URL.description: e.g. http://192.168.0.21:3001 - leave empty to hide

KUMA_SLUG.label: Uptime Kuma status page
KUMA_SLUG.description: Slug of a public status page, e.g. home

KUMA_CA_FILE.label: Uptime Kuma CA file
KUMA_CA_FILE.description: Path on the KVM to a private CA certificate (PEM)

KUMA_INSECURE.label: Uptime Kuma: skip TLS check
KUMA_INSECURE.description: true only for a self-signed certificate

PVE_URL.label: Proxmox URL
PVE_URL.description: e.g. https://192.168.0.30:8006 - leave empty to hide

PVE_INSECURE.label: Proxmox: allow self-signed TLS
PVE_INSECURE.description: true to skip certificate checks (typical for Proxmox)

PVE_CA_FILE.label: PVE: CA certificate file
PVE_CA_FILE.description: Optional path on the device to a PEM CA that signed the service's certificate (safer than *_INSECURE)

PROM_URL.label: Prometheus URL
PROM_URL.description: e.g. http://192.168.0.40:9090 - leave empty to hide

PROM_QUERIES.label: Prometheus queries
PROM_QUERIES.description: Label=PromQL; Label=PromQL (up to 6). Default: targets up / total

PROM_CA_FILE.label: Prometheus CA file
PROM_CA_FILE.description: Path on the KVM to a private CA certificate (PEM)

PROM_INSECURE.label: Prometheus: skip TLS check
PROM_INSECURE.description: true only for a self-signed certificate

K8S_URL.label: Kubernetes API URL
K8S_URL.description: e.g. https://192.168.0.50:6443 - leave empty to hide

K8S_TOKEN.label: Kubernetes token
K8S_TOKEN.description: ServiceAccount token with the read-only 'view' ClusterRole

K8S_CA_FILE.label: K8S: CA certificate file
K8S_CA_FILE.description: Optional path on the device to a PEM CA that signed the service's certificate (safer than *_INSECURE)

DOCKER_URL.label: Docker API URL
DOCKER_URL.description: e.g. http://192.168.0.60:2375 via docker-socket-proxy (read-only) - leave empty to hide

DOCKER_CA_FILE.label: DOCKER: CA certificate file
DOCKER_CA_FILE.description: Optional path on the device to a PEM CA that signed the service's certificate (safer than *_INSECURE)

DOCKER_INSECURE.label: Docker: skip TLS check
DOCKER_INSECURE.description: true only for a self-signed certificate
